title: Finding the Area of an 8 by 5 Rectangle
description: Counting rows and columns to find a rectangle's area without memorizing a formula.
narration_lines: What's the area of an 8 by 5 rectangle?
Picture it as a grid of little squares.
Count the rows, count the columns.
Rows times columns: 40 square units. That's it.
